name: comp-272
blurb: Bordered success alert with green icon.
description: Success alert with visible border using a green checkmark icon. More visually distinct success feedback than inline variant.
use_when: Prominently displaying successful completion or positive status at section or page level.
avoid_when: Minimal styling preference. When borders don't match existing design patterns.
a11y: No ARIA alert role. Icon hidden from screen readers. Parent must add role='status' and aria-live for accessibility.
